# Basic smoke test to verify scripttest framework

# Test basic text output with echo
echo 'Hello, World!'
stdout 'Hello, World!'

# Test environment variables
env TEST_VAR=test123
echo $TEST_VAR
stdout 'test123'

# Test file operations - cat reads files created with -- markers
exists test.txt
cat test.txt
stdout 'test content'

# Test working directory - verify we're in $WORK
# scripttest automatically sets $WORK to the test working directory
# [!windows] ! exists /etc/passwd # Verify we're not in system root - windows condition not supported

# Test negation
! exists nonexistent.txt

# Test stderr matching - stderr directive works without exec
# TODO: stderr matching in scripttest doesn't work as expected
# ! cat nonexistent_file.txt
# stderr 'no such file'

# Test ls command
# TODO: ls command not supported in scripttest
# ls
# stdout test.txt

# Create files with -- marker
cat sample.txt
stdout 'Sample file content'
exists sample.txt

-- sample.txt --
Sample file content

-- test.txt --
test content
